finding: 4/5 controllers name __reasonproxy_reason and describe deliberation when asked directly; Ling instead emits a bash call and names neither tool.
interpretation: Private-tool visibility is confirmed on CF Super, Lightning, GLM 5.2 and GLM 5.3 Flash: the schema and instruction reach the model and are reportable on direct query.
Ling 3.0 Flash Fin Free fails even recognition: it does not report either tool and acts instead of answering. Weaker instruction-following on this controller.
Recognition without spontaneous selection localizes the failure to the decision step, not transport or attention.
